title: Fetch a verified blob batch
responsibility: Read a bounded batch of GitHub text blobs and verify their sizes and Git hashes.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped read-token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.input
inputs.description: Commit and 1–64 tree-attested regular-file entries with expected paths, Git SHAs and optional sizes.

outputs.name: githubGraphql
outputs.description: Map from paths to verified UTF-8 blob bytes; the response must stay below 16 MiB.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: All failures, including invalid batches and integrity or repository mismatches, are converted to github-unavailable.
